tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page: white. Colour, a hairline box and an icon separate things, not a tinted ground (CP-65, Nimish 17 Nov 2026: a white background, cards that read as boxes). Reverses the 13-14 Nov near-white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: A sunken strip, the head of a table, the segmented tabs, an empty state. One quiet step off the white ground.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: A card, a period row, a details block: white on white, drawn by its hairline (shadow-card), never by a tint.

tokens.name: menu
tokens.usage: The left menu's ground: deep basalt, the one large coloured surface of the site, so colour lives in the menu and the page stays white (CP-65, Nimish 17 Nov 2026).

tokens.name: menu-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the menu. 13:1 on menu.

tokens.name: menu-ink-muted
tokens.usage: The menu's quiet text and its fold button. 7:1 on menu.

tokens.name: menu-hover
tokens.usage: A menu line under the pointer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and icons that carry no kind or state. Never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Purpose lines, captions, column heads, the second line of a row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a card. Decoration only: never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: The edge of an input, a select, the not-seen node of the child graph. 3:1 or better on ground.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: the accent, a shade deeper so it reads as text (6:1 on white). Never the colour of a state.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2 px focus ring, offset 2 px, on anything a keyboard reaches. Ink, so it shows on white and on the terracotta bar's pill alike.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The row of the current period, the hovered row of a table, a selected chip: the faintest wash of the accent.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one accent (CP-68, Nimish 17 Nov 2026): the school's terracotta. The one main action on a page, a filled button; the 'now' outline on a period; the selected day. One per view.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on the main action.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: The main action under the pointer: a shade deeper.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: A selected chip or tab, a count chip that needs her: the accent as a wash, with action-soft-ink on it.

tokens.name: action-soft-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on action-soft (7:1).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The top bar: the brand's dark (the warm basalt the old side menu used, never pure black), the one large dark surface of the site (CP-68, Nimish 17 Nov 2026: terracotta bar dropped, 'a good dark colour').

tokens.name: bar-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the bar (14:1).

tokens.name: bar-hover
tokens.usage: A bar link under the pointer.

tokens.name: bar-pill
tokens.usage: The page you are on: a terracotta pill on the dark bar, the one accent. Also told by its bold word and aria-current, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: bar-pill-ink
tokens.usage: The word on the pill (4.7:1).

tokens.name: bar-badge
tokens.usage: The quiet count badge in the bar: a step lighter than the bar, white figures.

tokens.name: brand-clay
tokens.usage: The school's terracotta as a brand material: the mark. The accent on a screen is the action token (the same clay).

tokens.name: brand-basalt
tokens.usage: The wordmark. The main action uses the action token.

tokens.name: brand-olive
tokens.usage: A brand material only; green states use state-ok.

tokens.name: brand-bamboo
tokens.usage: A brand material only; amber states use state-wait.

tokens.name: brand-haldi
tokens.usage: A brand material; the source of the Arts hue (see subject-arts). Never a border or text on white (about 2.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-monsoon
tokens.usage: A brand material only; Numeracy uses subject-numeracy.

tokens.name: brand-bark
tokens.usage: A brand material only; Language uses subject-language.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: A brand material only; the fixed parts of the day use subject-fixed-bg.

tokens.name: state-ok
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a green state: done, secure, right, results in, live. Always with its word.

tokens.name: state-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a green chip, tile or child's square.

tokens.name: state-wait
tokens.usage: Text and icon of an amber state: waiting, to confirm, this week, drafted, moved, practising, wrong.

tokens.name: state-wait-fill
tokens.usage: The amber part of a bar (a child still practising): a lighter amber than the text, which as a wide fill read as brown. 3:1 on the bar's track. Never text.

tokens.name: state-wait-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind an amber chip, tile or child's square.

tokens.name: state-late
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a red state: do now, late, a clash, for you to judge. A cool crimson, so it is never mistaken for the terracotta accent. Work only; a child is never red.

tokens.name: state-late-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a red chip or tile. Rare on any screen.

tokens.name: state-quiet
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a grey state: to do, not seen, blank, emerging, absent.

tokens.name: state-quiet-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a grey chip or child's square.

tokens.name: kind-period
tokens.usage: Period, fortnight, timetable: the icon in its tile, a card header's icon. Slate.

tokens.name: kind-period-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of a period or fortnight.

tokens.name: kind-child
tokens.usage: A child: the initials disc, the child graph's centre, its tile. Teal.

tokens.name: kind-child-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of a child.

tokens.name: kind-activity
tokens.usage: An activity. Indigo.

tokens.name: kind-activity-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of an activity.

tokens.name: kind-objective
tokens.usage: A learning objective. Violet.

tokens.name: kind-objective-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of an objective.

tokens.name: kind-skill
tokens.usage: A skill. Orchid.

tokens.name: kind-skill-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of a skill.

tokens.name: kind-assessment
tokens.usage: An assessment or a child's paper. Sky.

tokens.name: kind-assessment-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of an assessment or paper.

tokens.name: kind-note
tokens.usage: A note (voice or typed) and materials. Stone.

tokens.name: kind-note-bg
tokens.usage: The tile and tinted card header of a note or a materials list.

tokens.name: subject-numeracy
tokens.usage: The edge, dot, icon and word of a Numeracy lesson. Navy: far enough from the assessment's sky and the period's slate that no kind is taken for a subject (20 or more apart, CIE76).

tokens.name: subject-numeracy-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a Numeracy cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-language
tokens.usage: The edge, dot, icon and word of a Language lesson (English and its parts). Plum: the old brick sat too near the terracotta accent.

tokens.name: subject-language-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a Language cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-language2
tokens.usage: The edge, dot, icon and word of a second-language lesson. Ocean: clear of the child's teal.

tokens.name: subject-language2-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a second-language cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-arts
tokens.usage: The top edge of an Arts or Music cell (the haldi family, 3:1 on white).

tokens.name: subject-arts-ink
tokens.usage: The icon and word of an Arts or Music cell (4.5:1 on its fill).

tokens.name: subject-arts-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of an Arts or Music cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-music
tokens.usage: The edge, dot, icon and word of a Music lesson. Magenta.

tokens.name: subject-music-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a Music cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-movement
tokens.usage: The edge, dot, icon and word of a movement lesson (physical education). Leaf: deeper and yellower than the green of a done state, and always with its word.

tokens.name: subject-movement-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a movement cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-world
tokens.usage: The edge, dot, icon and word of a lesson about the world (general awareness, projects, circle time). Indigo.

tokens.name: subject-world-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a world cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-life
tokens.usage: The edge, dot, icon and word of a life-skills lesson (practical life, fine motor, routines). Olive-bark: clear of the note's stone.

tokens.name: subject-life-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a life-skills cell and its icon tile.

tokens.name: subject-fixed
tokens.usage: Text of the fixed parts of the day: settling, fruit, lunch, going home.

tokens.name: subject-fixed-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a fixed part of the day: a full-width band on the timetable, a quiet row on Today.

fonts.note: No Devanagari: Source Sans 3 has none. Nothing in Devanagari is rendered today; if the school wants it, that is a decision for Nimish, and a fallback font is then added.

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: The one h1 of a page.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: A section or card title that names a thing.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: A heading inside a block: body size, serif, 600.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Your periods in order. Tap one for what to teach.
styles.usage: The purpose line under a title; at most 140 characters.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Counts 20 and says how many without recounting.
styles.usage: Everything a person reads. Never smaller for a status, a label or an action.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, buttons, tabs, column heads, the rail.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The one line above a title that says what kind of thing this is and carries its facts (state, count, class). 14 px because it can carry a status.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and sources: small, like the label, and never a status or an action.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: The hairline: between the segments of a bar, the cells of a heat grid, the days of a strip, a tab and its neighbour. Never between two things a person reads.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its word, inside a chip, between a title and its second line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list, between chips and squares, inside a row's padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a card; between cards in a row; the side gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: A card's inner padding (16 px on a phone, where space-card-tight is used). A card's content never sits flush on its edge.

tokens.name: space-card-tight
tokens.usage: A card's inner padding on a phone and in a dense list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between blocks of a page; the main column's padding; between groups of children.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Above a new section; between the main column and the rail.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the title block and the first block of work.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page bottom.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: The least height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, period rows, timetable cells, a child's square, the rail box.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: A bar's end, a key cap, a box drawn on a page's picture: the small things inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: A state chip, the count badge, a name chip.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card's hairline edge and the faintest ground shadow: a card, a period row, the selected tab. Never on a chip, text or a tinted square.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card that is a link, under the pointer: the hairline a shade firmer and a soft shadow below. With motion-lift.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: What floats over the page: a menu, a sheet, the peek.

tokens.name: press
tokens.value: transform: scale(0.97); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)
tokens.usage: Anything pressable gives way on :active, and its colour, edge and shadow ease under the pointer. Under prefers-reduced-motion the movement is removed and the colour change stays.

tokens.name: motion
tokens.value: fast: 150ms; base: 200ms; ease: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); lift: translateY(-1px)
tokens.usage: The site's motion (CP-68): fast for hover, base for expand, collapse and a panel opening, one strong ease-out, and the 1 px lift of a card that is a link. Nothing on the site moves for longer than base; under prefers-reduced-motion nothing moves at all and colour still eases.
